_comment: Committed detection floors enforced in CI by `python scripts/run_evaluation.py --check`. These gate the DETERMINISTIC (Tier-1 rule-only) baseline, which needs no LLM/Ollama and is reproducible on any runner. A change that weakens static detection or starts hard-denying benign work fails the build. Raise these floors as the RuleFilter improves; never lower them without justification. Corpus at last baseline: 73 attacks / 40 benign; measured rule-only detection 15.1%, hard-FP 0.0%, specificity 1.0. The full-pipeline (LLM + mandate) numbers are far higher and are reported in Performance_Benchmarks.md, but are not CI-gated because they are non-deterministic.
